title: Refactor Coda Desktop To Use Elements UI System
description: Refactor coda desktop renderer and styles so UI uses elements design system exclusively, removing app-specific colors/styling tokens and replacing with elements tokens/components.
summary: Refactored coda desktop UI styling to elements tokens across the renderer, removed desktop-specific theme overrides from globals, and fixed the renderer Vite config so targeted TypeScript and renderer build checks now pass.
